newsitem.title: UK: UK's Karrimor buys Alpine distribution divisions.
newsitem.headline: UK's Karrimor buys Alpine distribution divisions.

text.p: Karrimor International, the UK outdoor clothing and equipment manufacturer, said on Sunday it had acquired the distribution divisions of the Lowe Alpine Group UK Ltd for over one million pounds.
Karrimor said the acquisition is expected to take its turnover from 19 million to 30 million pounds.

The new company will be called Europa Sportsystems and will hold the exclusive UK distribution rights for major sports brands including Rollerblade, Prince, Nordica, Kastle, Killer Loop and Asolo, recently purchased by the Benetton Group SpA, Karrimor said in a statement.

"This acquisition is a major step for Karrimor and will mean the the company is heavily involved across the sports and leisure market, as well as in outdoor clothing and equipment," said Chief Executive David Heys.

Karrimor said it plans to develop the product offerings and provide effective marketing support for the portfolio of brands. The company said it will takeover the logistics of the Europa Sportsystems brands from January 1, 1998.
